meta_description:
1M likes, 7,531 comments - selenagomez on October 15, 2026: "Six years of making mental health resources more accessible for young people.

Last night at the Rare Impact Fund Benefit, I looked around the room and felt so grateful to be surrounded by so many people who also believe in this mission.

We started the Rare Impact Fund with a simple hope: that young people would have better access to care, more places where they feel understood, and more people who know how to shot up when it matters. I’m so proud of the community that has grown around it.

To our nonprofit partners who do this work every day, and to everyone who joined us last night and continues to stand behind them: thank you. A special thank you to our sponsors - @rarebeauty, @afterpayusa, @batchandbox, @lululemon, @pacsun, @ultabeauty - for making this night possible, and to @seanhayes, @itsbellakayyy, @leonbridges, and @rae.sada for sharing their time and talent with us.

I hope everyone who asks for help knows they’re never alone, and that there will always be someone there to listen, support them, and remind them they matter. ❤️".
